record.question: Which of the following best describes the difference between relative, absolute, and mixed references in Excel?
options: Relative references remain fixed, absolute change with copying
Absolute references change with copying, relative stay constant
Relative adjust automatically, absolute remain fixed, mixed lock either row or column
record.explanation: Relative references change when copied; absolute references preserve row and column; a mixed reference fixes only one of them. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/excel/switch-between-relative-absolute-and-mixed-references
